title: Viewport Explorer
description: Practise view modes, bookmarks, and camera speed controls.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Become fluent with advanced viewport features.

1. Place a few Static Mesh actors (cubes, spheres) from the **Place Actors** panel.
2. Select one actor and press **F** to focus.
3. Switch view modes using shortcuts: **Alt+2** (Unlit), **Alt+3** (Wireframe), **Alt+4** (Lit). Observe the differences.
4. Under the **Show** dropdown, enable **Collision** to see collision shapes.
5. Press **G** to enter Game View, then again to exit.
6. Save a camera bookmark: press **Ctrl+1** while looking at a point. Move away, then press **1** to jump back.
7. Practise flying with **Shift** (fast) and **Ctrl** (slow) held down.
hints: If you can't see collision, make sure the actor actually has collision (most shapes do by default).
Bookmarks work per‑level; they don't carry over between levels.
expectedOutput: You can quickly change view modes, use bookmarks, and vary camera speed.
